contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.text: If you need help building or improving a web project, have a collaboration idea, or just have questions – I’m always available!
contact.textSecond: You can reach me via email or social media, or use the form on the right to send me a message directly. I try to respond as quickly as possible.
contact.textWait: Looking forward to hearing from you! 🚀

projects.githubFinder: An application that allows you to find a user by their username and display all their repositories. Uses the GitHub API to fetch data.
projects.skVerh: Corporate website for a construction company. Developed from scratch: implemented responsive layout, built a custom WordPress theme, integrated admin panel for easy content management.
projects.golovko: A website for an interior design studio. Custom post types were implemented for projects with individual fields like style, area, layout, and before/after photos. Easy-to-manage admin panel for content updates.

loneMagnet.short: A custom e-commerce website on WordPress + WooCommerce with a React-based image cropping app and full automation of order processing.
loneMagnet.long:
This project showcases my ability to combine WordPress flexibility with custom React solutions.

📌 Developed a custom WordPress theme with a responsive layout and optimized performance.

📌 Configured WooCommerce and integrated multiple online payment methods.

📌 Built a React app for image cropping: uploaded images are automatically applied as product thumbnails in the shopping cart.

📌 Enhanced the admin experience: order details include image previews and the ability to download all files as a ZIP archive.

📌 Implemented automatic PDF generation from uploaded images, making them ready for instant printing.

📌 Integrated Telegram notifications so new orders are delivered to the admin in real time.
loneMagnet.key:
Key achievements:

🔹 Advanced WooCommerce customization and REST API usage.

🔹 Integrating React apps into WordPress workflow.

🔹 Automating business processes with PDF/ZIP generation and instant notifications.

portfolio.title: My portfolio
portfolio.short: A modern personal portfolio built with Vue 3, Vite, TailwindCSS, and Node.js backend for contact form automation.
portfolio.long:
This project demonstrates my skills in building modern, responsive web applications with Vue 3.

📌 Developed a fully responsive Vue 3 frontend with Vite for fast build and preview.

📌 Implemented a multi-language interface using Vue I18n.

📌 Created dynamic project gallery with Masonry layout and lightbox viewing.

📌 Built a Node.js + Express backend for contact form submissions with email notifications via Nodemailer.

📌 Ensured code quality with ESLint and Prettier, and optimized styles using TailwindCSS and Sass.
portfolio.key:
Key achievements:

🔹 Developed a fully responsive, multi-language Vue 3 portfolio.

🔹 Integrated dynamic gallery with Masonry layout and lightbox.

🔹 Automated contact form handling with Node.js, Express, and email notifications.

🔹 Maintained high code quality with ESLint and Prettier, and optimized styles with TailwindCSS and Sass.

about.text: Hi, I’m Vitali. Originally from a small village, now I’m living in the USA and making the web a better place one website at a time. I’ve been a frontend developer since 2019, focusing on clean, functional code and user-friendly designs. I’m passionate about building websites that not only look great but also work perfectly.
about.textFirst: I work with modern technologies like React, Vue, TypeScript, and Sass. I pay attention to performance, accessibility, and responsive design — because a good website should feel right on every screen.
about.textSec: For me, frontend is not just about code — it’s about solving problems and creating interfaces that make users' lives easier.
about.textThree: I enjoy working in teams, sharing knowledge, and keeping the workflow smooth and positive — no drama, just clean commits.
about.stackWP: Old tech? Maybe. Still awesome? Definitely. I use WordPress to build sites that feel anything but outdated. And no, I don’t install 47 plugins to make a button work.
about.outsideSubTitle: When I’m not writing code, I enjoy:
about.outsideItemOne: 🧭 Traveling – exploring new cities and cultures inspires my creative work.
about.outsideItemTwo: 📸 Photography – I love capturing moments that reflect the atmosphere of the places I visit.
about.outsideItemThree: 📚 Reading – I’m into fiction and self-growth books that fuel new perspectives and personal development.
about.outsideItemFour: 🎸 Music – I play the guitar to relax and stay balanced between work and life.
